title: Chapter 48
text: The things that happen behind closed doors in the Riders Quadrant in order to turn young cadets into full-fledged riders are enough to turn even the staunchest of stomachs. Those prone to queasiness should not pry. —M AJOR A FENDRA ’ S G UIDE TO THE R IDERS Q UADRANT (U NAUTHORIZED E DITION )
